tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Fetch any public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (or plain text) with title, author, date and language. Boilerplate (menus, cookie banners, footers) removed. Respects robots.txt. ~1-3 s. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.002 per call via x402 at https://2-29-135-242.sslip.io

tools.name: domain_intel
tools.description: One call for a domain: RDAP registration (registrar, created, expires, status, nameservers, DNSSEC) from the official IANA RDAP servers, live DNS (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA, SPF, DMARC) and the TLS certificate (issuer, expiry, days left, SANs). Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.005 per call via x4

tools.name: federal_register
tools.description: Search the official US Federal Register: final rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents with abstract, agencies, publication date and links. Filter by keyword, type, agency and date. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.005 per call via x402 at https://2-29-135-242.sslip.io/x402/fede

tools.name: clinical_trials
tools.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov (official v2 API) by keyword, condition, intervention, sponsor or location. Returns NCT id, title, status, phases, enrollment, conditions, interventions, sponsor, dates and countries. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.005 per call via x402 at https://2-29-135-242.sslip.io

tools.name: prediction_markets
tools.description: Search open prediction markets on Polymarket and Kalshi in one call: event, market, outcome prices (implied probability 0-1), volume, liquidity/open interest, end date and link. Sorted by volume. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.005 per call via x402 at https://2-29-135-242.sslip.io/x402/predicti

tools.name: osv_vulns

Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.002 per call via x402 at https://2-29-135-242.sslip.io/x402/osv-vulns.

tools.name: email_auth
tools.description: Email deliverability and spoofing check for a domain in one call: MX + mail provider, SPF (all qualifier, DNS lookup count vs the limit of 10), DMARC policy/pct/reporting, DKIM keys on 20+ common selectors (or yours), MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI, with a 0-100 score, grade and plain-English issues. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "web_read" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_read, email_auth · Private data: federal_register · Public sink: email_auth.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_read, email_auth · Private data: federal_register · Public sink: email_auth

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
